# Giorgi Khvichia

> The portfolio of Giorgi Khvichia, a full-stack software engineer in Tbilisi, Georgia. He builds whole products: web platforms, 3D experiences, AI tools and hardware. Founder of shemoqmedi.space.

## This site

- [Portfolio](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/): the home page with his skills and stack, the sites he has built, a few photos, and how to reach him
- [CV, English (PDF)](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/cv/Giorgi-Khvichia-CV.pdf): experience, projects, education, awards and technical skills
- [CV, Georgian (PDF)](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/cv/Giorgi-Khvichia-CV-KA.pdf): the same CV in Georgian

## Case studies

- [Shemoqmedi, case study](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/work/shemoqmedi): a platform for Georgia's web designers, developers and digital creators, with a developing awards community. Role: founder, product design, full-stack engineering
- [Kencho Room, case study](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/work/kencho-room): an interactive room for a custom-furniture brand. Role: creative developer, interactive engineering. Client project, delivered
- [Kencho Group, case study](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/work/kencho-group): the main website of a custom-furniture business. Role: full-stack and frontend implementation, end-to-end delivery. Client project, delivered
- [Kalami, case study](https://khvichia.shemoqmedi.space/work/kalami): an educational platform shaped by real classroom needs. Role: creator, full-stack engineer, university lecturer. Active university pilot

## Work

- [shemoqmedi.space](https://www.shemoqmedi.space/): web design awards
- [The Room by Kencho Group](https://room.kenchogroup.ge/): a 3D furniture room
- [Kencho Group](https://www.kenchogroup.ge/): a custom furniture studio
- [Kalami](https://www.kalami.space/): a learning platform for universities
